mainEntity.name: What does an interior project manager do on an office fit out?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project manager owns the programme, budget and quality from the first brief to handover. That covers appointing and coordinating designers and contractors, tracking cost against the approved budget, managing authority approvals, chairing site meetings and reporting progress to you every week.

mainEntity.name: Can you manage a fit out when we have our own contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our fit out project management service works with your chosen contractor or the landlord's team. We review drawings, check quotes, monitor progress on site and sign off quality before payments are released.

mainEntity.name: Which approvals do you manage in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Landlord and building NOC, Dubai Municipality fit out permit, Dubai Civil Defence drawings, inspection and completion, DEWA load approvals, and free-zone approvals such as DDA, DMCC, DIFC and Trakhees.

mainEntity.name: Which approvals do you manage in Abu Dhabi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Landlord NOC, the municipality building permit through the Department of Municipalities and Transport, Abu Dhabi Civil Defence approval and final inspection, utility load approvals, and free-zone approvals in ADGM, Masdar City and KEZAD.

mainEntity.name: How long do fit out approvals take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most office approvals take 2-6 weeks, depending on the authority, the building and how complete the drawings are. We submit early and run approvals alongside design development so they do not hold up the start on site.

mainEntity.name: How do you control fit out costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: We set a cost plan at concept stage, tender packages to compare like for like, propose value engineering options before work starts and report committed and forecast cost every week, so there are no surprises at final account.
Yes. Every project has a weekly report with progress photos, programme status, cost status, risks, and decisions needed from you.

body: A fit out has dozens of moving parts: designers, contractors, landlords, authorities and your own team. Our interior project management service puts one experienced project manager in charge of all of them, so your office is delivered on programme, on budget and fully approved.
We manage fit out approvals with Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, DEWA and the free zones, control cost from the first estimate to the final account, and report progress to you every week.
